id: 04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario
title: 新实验，先评估
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/04_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Risk Management Scenario/src.py

points.K2: 先查现有风险评估和规程
points.K5: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，举着一块空白写字板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench holding up a blank clipboard with a magnifier icon.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：接到新实验怎么办？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 看完故事，请你一起来想答案。

shots.scene: 老周把一张空白任务卡交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank task card to the female graduate student in the laboratory.
shots.narration: 想象一下：你被安排做一项新操作。

shots.scene: 小研戴紫色手套，托着一只长满红色菌落的琼脂平板
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the female graduate student's hands in purple nitrile gloves holding an agar plate covered with red bacterial colonies, the bench blurred behind.
shots.narration: 这是实验室里一项新的操作。

shots.scene: 小研看着平板，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles looks at the agar plate in her gloved hand, thinking.
shots.narration: 以前没做过，心里有点没底。

shots.section_title: 先查现有风险评估和规程
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank risk assessment form on her desk.
shots.narration: 你先查阅现有的风险评估表，
overlay: 先查现有风险评估和规程

shots.section_title: 先查现有风险评估和规程
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的规程文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips through a blank standard operating procedure binder.
shots.narration: 再把手头的操作规程都看一遍。

shots.section_title: 先查现有风险评估和规程
shots.scene: 表格上几行打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with several rows checked in green. No people.
shots.narration: 现有的文件，都认真读过了。

shots.scene: 表格最后一行空白，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The bottom row of the blank checklist is empty, with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 但是，你还是有些担心，

shots.scene: 小研眉头紧锁，身旁浮现一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns; a yellow warning triangle icon floats beside her.
shots.narration: 这项新操作，可能带来额外的风险。

shots.scene: 平板图标旁浮现一个带问号的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An agar plate icon next to a warning triangle with a question mark inside. No people.
shots.narration: 现有的文件，未必都考虑到了。

shots.scene: 小研放下平板，站在台前犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the agar plate down on the bench and stands hesitating.
shots.narration: 问题来了：这时，你该怎么做？

shots.scene: 小研头顶浮现一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A big question mark floats above the female graduate student's head.
shots.narration: 你该怎么做？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 给自己一点时间，好好想想。

shots.scene: 小研在空白本子上列清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a list in a blank notebook, thinking.
shots.narration: 把你会采取的做法，一条条列出来。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现任务卡和平板图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a task card and an agar plate.
shots.narration: 接到一项新操作，

shots.scene: 风险评估表和规程手册图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a risk assessment form and a procedure binder, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 先查了风险评估和规程，

shots.scene: 警示三角和问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon next to a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还担心有额外的风险，该怎么办？

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 这道题，留给你自己找答案。

shots.scene: 欣欣把空白写字板递向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds the blank clipboard out toward the camera.
shots.narration: 想好答案了吗？记在心里。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研站在实验台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student wave goodbye beside the lab bench.
shots.narration: 带着问题去思考，下次见！
